new_method: MCS crossed-functional bootstrap-t proposed extension v2

mechanism_and_limits.change_1: recompute full seed+time HAC covariance studentizer for each bootstrap draw
mechanism_and_limits.change_2: observed pair studentizer from plug-in crossed covariance rather than bootstrap dispersion
mechanism_and_limits.control_1: old functional_mcs copied verbatim and pinned; same observed risks and same already-drawn bootstrap risks, no additional draws
mechanism_and_limits.control_2: new plug-in observed covariance with fixed bootstrap studentizer; same bootstrap roots, isolates re-studentization within the new covariance construction
mechanism_and_limits.not_claimed: Standard MCS does not require bootstrap-t; no unique old failure cause established; temporal lag bias remains.

budget_stop_policy: Stop before next replicate after budget; retain partial records, no rerun/new seeds to obtain success
